客户端注入 CSS/设置入口，Host 暴露配置 API；可选 Python helper 修改 app.asar 并借文件通道向 Electron 主进程请求窗口材质。
静态审阅 README、client.js、index.js、asarpatch.py；未运行插件或修改宿主。
package v0.2.0、MIT，peer DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；适配作者声明未独立验证。

# AIR-pixel Liquid Glass > 为 DSH Web 提供磨砂玻璃主题、壁纸、光标、波纹和对话对比度设置；桌面透明/模糊需显式修改宿主 app.asar。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass](https://github.com/AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass) - **版本号**：0.2.0（[固定提交 4b980fb2cbac292274a6b3136696ab27e3b1decc](https://github.com/AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass/tree/4b980fb2cbac292274a6b3136696ab27e3b1decc)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-18（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 主题源代码与补丁路径可核，真实视觉未验；配置 API 通配 CORS 且持久化失败仍返回成功，有待核外层访问控制。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：个人用户希望改善 DSH 界面外观和长对话可读性。 - **亮点**：主题涵盖表面、壁纸、光标、波纹和分侧对比度；详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **思考**：桌面透明需要用户修改安装归档，升级可能失效；配置写路由的跨源和失败处理仍有缺口。详见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。 - **建议**：把补丁状态与效果验证暴露给用户并收紧配置写入，可降低主题试用风险；需目标宿主验证。详见[Q04](#research-q04)。 采用建议：先试普通主题，再于可回滚副本核补丁、窗口材质和更新后恢复；详见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 核心贡献 主题涵盖表面、壁纸、光标、波纹和分侧对比度；详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 关键质疑 桌面透明需要用户修改安装归档，升级可能失效；配置写路由的跨源和失败处理仍有缺口。详见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 把补丁状态与效果验证暴露给用户并收紧配置写入，可降低主题试用风险；需目标宿主验证。详见[Q04](#research-q04)。 目标 Windows/Web 视觉和性能对照；核 webServer 外层访问控制、写入失败状态和宿主补丁更新/回滚。 ## 场景与替代办法 个人用户希望改善 DSH 界面外观和长对话可读性。 DSH 默认 UI；插件提供可配置玻璃质感和可选桌面透出。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 条件 | 条件 | 用途 | 缺失时 | | --- | --- | --- | | DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 | 声明兼容 | 版本可能失效 | | Windows/Electron | 桌面材质 | 只用普通主题 | | app.asar 备份 | 补丁回滚 | 恢复困难 | #### 试用 | 步骤 | 动作 | 判据 | | --- | --- | --- | | 普通主题 | 调对比度/光标 | 文字可读 | | 补丁副本 | check/备份/应用 | 材质状态准确 | | 恢复 | revert/更新 | 不影响宿主启动 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 资源与人工 | 边界 | | --- | --- | --- | | 普通主题 | 安装、调色和可读性检查 | 低端设备性能未知 | | 桌面透明 | 备份并修改 app.asar | 升级/版本适配需维护 | #### 效果 | 项 | 源码支持 | 未知 | | --- | --- | --- | | 界面皮肤 | CSS、光标、波纹 | 实机可读性 | | 透明窗 | 补丁/文件通道 | 目标系统效果 | | 配置 | JSON API | 外层访问控制 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标：**核实主题视觉能力、桌面透明所需宿主补丁及本地配置路由边界。 ### Q01 · 插件改变了哪些界面体验？ **研究主题：**场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 插件为 DSH Web 注入磨砂表面、壁纸、光标、点击波纹和人/助手分侧对比度设置，Host 持有 JSON 配置，客户端渲染 CSS 和设置页。它面向希望定制桌面外观与长会话可读性的个人用户。README 的图片是 stand-in shell 上渲染的合成图，不是实际 DSH 截屏；本轮没有在目标宿主目测最终效果。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:1-38](https://github.com/AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass/blob/4b980fb2cbac292274a6b3136696ab27e3b1decc/README.md#L1-L38) 作者说明功能且披露截图为合成渲染。
查看原文（38行） ```text # AIR-pixel Liquid Glass A configurable Liquid Glass theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It adds translucent interface surfaces, an optional wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-side conversation contrast controls. ## Screenshots Full transparency: strength 2.0 (效果强度) with desktop transparency on (透出桌面), so the desktop reaches the eye unfiltered. The per-side conversation plates are what keep the body copy readable this far up the slider. ![Liquid Glass with desktop transparency](assets/preview-transparent.png) The same screen with and without the theme: ![The stock shell beside Liquid Glass](assets/preview-vs-stock.png) At the default strength, over the theme's own wallpaper — sidebar, pane, dialog, menu and floating panel: ![Frosted panels at the default strength](assets/preview-surfaces.png) | Custom cursors | Click ripple | | --- | --- | | ![The five shipped cursors](assets/preview-cursors.png) | ![A click ripple, held](assets/preview-ripple.png) | The four tint presets, light and dark: ![Tint presets in light and dark](assets/preview-tints.png) These are renders, not photographs. `node tools/docshots.mjs` boots the real `client.js` in a stand-in shell over a drawn desktop. A screen capture cannot show this feature at all: `PrintWindow` drops the alpha channel, so a see-through window comes back as a black rectangle — measured in `tools/appshot.py`. ## Features - Frosted surfaces with adjustable strength, blur, tint, and wallpaper. - Optional transparent desktop and Windows window material controls. Desktop transparency requires the included client patch helper; the setting reports when the patch is unavailable. - Custom cursors and click ripples, each independently configurable. - Separate contrast settings for human and assistant messages. - English and Chinese settings UI. ## Install ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[client.js:1902-1906](https://github.com/AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass/blob/4b980fb2cbac292274a6b3136696ab27e3b1decc/client.js#L1902-L1906) 按配置注入光标/波纹 CSS。 ```text // ---- cursors ---------------------------------------------------------- if (config.cursor) parts.push(cursorDeclarations()); // ---- ripple ----------------------------------------------------------- if (config.ripple) parts.push(rippleCss(intensity, drop, config.rippleSize)); ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[client.js:3464-3508](https://github.com/AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass/blob/4b980fb2cbac292274a6b3136696ab27e3b1decc/client.js#L3464-L3508) 注册语言字典与设置入口。
查看原文（45行） ```text ctx.effect(() => ctx.locale.register(NS, { zh, en }), 'liquid-glass: dictionaries'); const t = ctx.locale.bind(NS); ctx.effect(() => { applyTheme(); // The wallpaper is a single layer whose gradient is scheme-specific, so // a light/dark flip has to repaint it. Watching the attribute is cheaper // and far more reliable than listening for whatever toggles the theme. const observer = new MutationObserver(() => { const el = document.getElementById(WALLPAPER_ID); if (el !== null) delete el.dataset.signature; paintWallpaper(); }); observer.observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-ds-dark-theme'] }); return () => { observer.disconnect(); const tag = document.getElementById(STYLE_ID); if (tag !== null) tag.remove(); dropWallpaper(); dropLiquidDefs(); }; }, 'liquid-glass: theme sheet'); ctx.effect(() => installRipples(), 'liquid-glass: click ripples'); ctx.slots.inject(SECTION_SLOT, () => ctx.slots.register({ name: SECTION_SLOT, id: 'liquid-glass', order: 42, label: () => t('nav'), locale: NS, children: { [ITEM_SLOT]: { kind: 'list', scope: 'root' } } }, LiquidGlassSection) ); ctx.slots.inject(ITEM_SLOT, () => ctx.slots.register({ name: ITEM_SLOT, id: 'panel', order: 0, locale: NS ```
#### 缺口 - 未在 DSH 目标版本运行主题。 **影响：**真实视觉、性能与易读性未证实。 **进一步探讨：**在目标 Windows/Web 宿主比较默认/主题界面并采集对比度和帧率。 ### Q02 · 桌面透明和窗口模糊如何启用？ **研究主题：**功能与机制、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 普通主题 CSS 可以由插件直接注入；真正透出桌面的透明窗口和 Windows 窗口材质则依赖用户显式运行 asarpatch.py 修改已安装的 app.asar。脚本会核查归档结构/完整性、先备份并支持 --check/--revert；补丁将主进程 watcher 加入归档，Host 通过文件请求/回执与主进程通信。DSH 更新后补丁可能消失，需要按目标版本重新核对，不宜把开关等同于已经生效。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:39-66](https://github.com/AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass/blob/4b980fb2cbac292274a6b3136696ab27e3b1decc/README.md#L39-L66) 安装/兼容性说明透明与模糊需要补丁，支持 0.2.1-rc.2。
查看原文（28行） ````text Install `air-pixel-liquid-glass` as a DeepSeek Harness bundle, then enable **Liquid Glass** in Settings. The desktop transparency and window blur controls need their host-side patch; the theme and other visual options do not. ## Development Requires Node.js. Run the syntax and behavior checks with: ```powershell node tools/preflight.mjs node tools/verify.mjs node tools/patcheck.mjs node tools/mutationaudit.mjs ``` Regenerate the images above with `node tools/docshots.mjs` (writes `assets/`, which `screenshots.json` points the plugin market at). Some visual inspection scripts need Python with Pillow. See [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md) for architecture, checks, and rename migration details. ## Compatibility Designed for DeepSeek Harness on Windows and the web GUI. Desktop transparency and window blur depend on the installed Harness build and supported Windows compositor APIs. Verified against Harness core `0.2.1-rc.2`; that is the only core this version declares support for. The slots seat moved into the core's client runner in the 0.2.x line, so `0.1.x` cores are out — stay on plugin `0.1.0` there. ## Permissions and behavior The plugin injects theme styles and custom cursors into the Harness web UI, reads and writes its own JSON settings through a local host API, and logs diagnostic status through the host logger. The optional `tools/asarpatch.py` helper modifies the installed Harness `app.asar` only when run explicitly by the user; it keeps a backup and supports checking or reverting the patch. The plugin does not make external network requests. ## License MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). ````
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[tools/asarpatch.py:663-685](https://github.com/AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass/blob/4b980fb2cbac292274a6b3136696ab27e3b1decc/tools/asarpatch.py#L663-L685) 显式 check/revert/staging/apply 参数。
查看原文（23行） ```text def main(): ap = argparse.ArgumentParser() ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="report state and exit") ap.add_argument("--revert", action="store_true", help="restore the backup") ap.add_argument( "--material", choices=MATERIALS, default="none", help="what the window should show behind itself: none = the desktop " "itself, sharp (default); acrylic = DWM's blurred copy of it", ) ap.add_argument("--staging", metavar="PATH", help="write here instead of installing") ap.add_argument( "--apply-staged", action="store_true", help="install an already-verified app.asar.new without repacking", ) ap.add_argument( "--print-watcher", action="store_true", help="write the window-material watcher to stdout and exit", ) args = ap.parse_args() ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[tools/asarpatch.py:777-955](https://github.com/AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass/blob/4b980fb2cbac292274a6b3136696ab27e3b1decc/tools/asarpatch.py#L777-L955) 验证归档、备份和替换安装文件。
查看原文（179行） ```text if args.check: print("not patched") return 1 if not watcher_only: hits = text.count(OLD) if hits != 1: print(f"the win32 primary block matched {hits} times, expected exactly 1") print("the archive is from a different DSH build; the patch needs re-deriving") return 2 # Before mutating anything: confirm the integrity formula reproduces the # hashes already in the archive. This has to happen against the untouched # header, because it resolves each member through its stored offset. # # The gate is a MATCH RATE, not "zero mismatches". Measured on the shipped # archive: 9 of 11470 records are already stale, so requiring a clean sheet # would refuse a patch the app itself is perfectly happy to run. A wrong # formula would fail nearly all of them, so 95% separates the two cases # with a lot of room. The stale ones are reported rather than hidden — they # are pre-existing, not introduced here. # # A raw byte-count check is deliberately NOT used as the structural test: # re-serialising the header can legitimately change its length when an # offset crosses a power of ten, and asserting otherwise would flag a # correct repack. The read-back below is the real test. checked, bad = verify_integrity_against(header, base, raw) rate = (checked - len(bad)) / checked if checked else 0.0 if rate < 0.95: print("REFUSING TO PATCH — the integrity formula does not describe this archive:") print(f" only {rate:.1%} of {checked} records reproduced ({len(bad)} mismatched)") print(f" first mismatch: {bad[0]}") return 3 print(f"integrity formula confirmed on {checked} records ({rate:.2%} reproduced)") if bad: print(f" {len(bad)} record(s) were already stale in the shipped archive:") for path in bad[:9]: print(f" · {path}") if watcher_only: new_text = text + build_watcher() else: new_text = text.replace(OLD, build_new(args.material)) + build_watcher() new_bytes = new_text.encode("utf-8") old_off = int(target["offset"]) delta = len(new_bytes) - len(before[MEMBER]) # Rebuild the body region as: everything before main.js, the patched # main.js, everything after. Members before main.js keep their offsets; # every member after it moves right by exactly the growth. prefix_len = old_off prefix = raw[base : base + prefix_len] suffix = raw[base + prefix_len + len(before[MEMBER]) :] body = prefix + new_bytes + suffix for path, entry in members.items(): if not has_body(entry): continue raw_off = entry["offset"] off = int(raw_off) if off > old_off: moved = off + delta # Offsets are stored as STRINGS in this archive. `off + delta` # silently produced an int, which quietly cost two bytes per member # (the quotes) — 26 members, 52 bytes, and the only reason it was # noticed is the read-back verification. Preserve the original type # rather than trusting that a reader will coerce it. entry["offset"] = str(moved) if isinstance(raw_off, str) else moved target["size"] = len(new_bytes) # The patched member's own hash, recomputed. Its blocks are unchanged in # count: main.js is 490 KB against a 4 MB blockSize, so one block. if "integrity" in target: block_size = int(target["integrity"].get("blockSize", 4194304)) target["integrity"] = integrity_for(new_bytes, block_size) out = emit(header, body) # --- verification ----------------------------------------------------- # The only thing that makes a repack trustworthy is reading it back and # comparing every untouched byte against the snapshot. A repacked archive # that loads but silently truncates a module would be far worse than no # patch at all, and nothing about it would be visible until something # obscure broke weeks later. problems = [] try: o_header, o_base, _ = parse(out) except SystemExit as error: print(f"REPACK FAILED — the result does not parse: {error}") return 3 o_members = dict(walk(o_header)) if set(o_members) != set(members): problems.append("member set changed") for path, entry in o_members.items(): if not has_body(entry): continue off = int(entry["offset"]) size = int(entry["size"]) if o_base + off + size > len(out): problems.append(f"{path}: runs past the end of the archive") continue got = out[o_base + off : o_base + off + size] want = new_bytes if path == MEMBER else before.get(path) if want is None: problems.append(f"{path}: has no original body to compare against") elif got != want: problems.append(f"{path}: body differs from the original") # Types matter: the shipped archive stores offsets as strings, and a # reader that coerces is not a guarantee that every reader does. if type(entry["offset"]) is not type(members[path]["offset"]): problems.append(f"{path}: offset type changed to {type(entry['offset']).__name__}") # The patched member's hash must describe the bytes that are actually there. main_rec = o_members[MEMBER].get("integrity") if main_rec is not None: want_rec = integrity_for(new_bytes, int(main_rec.get("blockSize", 4194304))) if want_rec["hash"] != main_rec.get("hash"): problems.append("lib/main.js: integrity hash does not match the patched bytes") if want_rec["blocks"] != list(main_rec.get("blocks", [])): problems.append("lib/main.js: integrity blocks do not match the patched bytes") # Walk order must cover the body region exactly once: no gaps, no overlaps. cursor = 0 for path, entry in walk(o_header): if not has_body(entry): continue if int(entry["offset"]) != cursor: problems.append( f"gap or overlap before {path}: offset {entry['offset']} but cursor {cursor}" ) break cursor = int(entry["offset"]) + int(entry["size"]) if cursor != len(out) - o_base: problems.append( f"body region ends at {cursor}, archive has {len(out) - o_base} bytes of body" ) if problems: print("REPACK FAILED — nothing written:") for p in problems[:20]: print(" ·", p) return 3 print(f"verified {len(o_members)} members read back, every untouched body byte-identical") print(f" lib/main.js {len(before[MEMBER])} -> {len(new_bytes)} bytes ({delta:+d}), hash rewritten") print(f" archive {len(raw)} -> {len(out)} bytes") if args.staging: Path(args.staging).write_bytes(out) print(f"staged -> {args.staging}") return 0 if not backup.exists(): shutil.copy2(ASAR, backup) print(f"backup -> {backup.name}") tmp = ASAR.parent / (ASAR.name + ".new") try: tmp.write_bytes(out) tmp.replace(ASAR) print(f"patched -> {ASAR.name}") except (PermissionError, OSError) as error: # Keep the repacked archive on disk: it is already verified, so once # DSH is closed the whole job is a rename rather than a re-run. print(f"could not replace the archive: {error}") print(f"DSH is holding it open.
